# pantechdynamics_plan (Data Source)

Looks up one compute plan by slug. Use it to fail early on a wrong slug, and to read a plan's size and price. Use pantechdynamics_plans to list them all.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look one plan up by slug. A wrong slug fails the plan with the list of valid ones.
data "pantechdynamics_plan" "small" {
  slug = "individual"

  # placement = "vpc" # Plans and prices differ for instances in a VPC.
}

output "upfront_cost_minor" {
  value = data.pantechdynamics_plan.small.initial_payment_minor
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Slug of the plan to look up, for example "individual". It must match exactly. The lookup fails if no plan has it.

### Optional

- `placement` (String) Which kind of instance to look the plan up for: "standard" (a VPS with a public IP, the default) or "vpc" (a VM in a customer VPC). Plans and prices differ between the two.

### Read-Only

- `disk_gb` (Number) Root disk size in gigabytes.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the plan.
- `initial_payment_minor` (Number) Estimated amount due when the instance is ordered, in minor currency units.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory in megabytes.
- `monthly_estimate_minor` (Number) Estimated cost of running the plan for a full month, in minor currency units (for example kobo or cents). An estimate from a display-only cache, not a quote.
- `name` (String) Display name of the plan.
- `price_currency` (String) Currency of the prices below, in your account's currency. Null when the plan is unpriced.
- `storage_floor_minor` (Number) Estimated cost of a full month while the instance is stopped, in minor currency units.
- `unpriced_reason` (String) Why no price is available, or null when the plan is priced.
- `vcpu` (Number) Number of virtual CPUs.
